Barcelona, Spain

Coined 'the hotel with a thousand eyes', this five-star hotel's neoclassical design has been hijacked by sculptor Frederic Amat, who pinned hundreds of ceramic eyes on its front. The extravagant tone set by the exterior continues throughout your stay, with facilities that ensure your experience is equal parts comfortable and exciting. Indulge in a swim at the clear-sided rooftop swimming pool, savour a meal at Michelin-starred French restaurant from Romain Fornell or relax at the rooftop terrace with its celebrated bar shaking up excellent concoctions and aperitifs. Found in the heart of the Gothic Quarter, this five-star hotel is surrounded by a vibrant array of restaurants, shops, bars and cafes.

Five-Star Barcelona Luxury at Spain's #1 Hotel with Daily Breakfast

Barcelona, Spain

Experience the vibrancy of Barcelona from the Best Hotel in Spain and Portugal, as voted by the 2020 Condé Nast Traveler Readers’ Choice Awards: the five-star Almanac Barcelona. Boasting an address to impress just steps from Spain's answer to the Champs-Elysées - the prominent Passeig de Gràcia - this sumptuous hotel takes you to the heart of the action in style and luxury. Wake up in one of the beautifully styled rooms and immerse yourself in the pulsing streets of Barcelona. Discover Gaudi’s masterpieces, Casa Batlló and Casa Milà, take a five-minute stroll to reach the bustling Las Ramblas boulevard and the historic streets of the old city, taste tapas with locals, then retreat to the hotel’s rooftop bar to toast your five-star city escape. Styled by local designer Jaime Beriestain, the hotel showcases contemporary décor with a wealth of textures and exquisite living spaces. Its long list of impeccable facilities includes a wellness centre, spa and the acclaimed, plant-focused restaurant VIRENS, serving exquisite dishes such as artichokes with candied flowers and Chinese cabbage dumplings (there's organic meat and fish too for the carnivores). The jewel in the hotel’s crown? The majestic, multitiered rooftop terrace, which offers spectacular views over Barcelona’s skyline, a sparkling pool and a laidback bar, Azimuth. Visit for yourself and discover why this stunning hotel is rated among Tripadvisor's top 1% worldwide, earning it a spot in the top luxury hotels in Spain at the Travellers' Choice 2020 Best of the Best awards. **Luxury Escapes inclusions (select nights)** - Indulgent **daily à la carte breakfast** served in the elegant surroundings of VIRENS restaurant - A **welcome cocktail, glass of wine or sparkling on arrival** to celebrate your city escape (for stays of 2+ nights) - **Complimentary upgrade to the next room category**, subject to availability (for stays of 4+ nights, excludes Almanac Suite) - **EUR25 food and drinks credit per room** to spend at the hotel’s restaurant and rooftop bar (for stays of 6+ nights) **Travelling with kids?** Check out the Family Upgrade for two adults and one child (aged 11 years and under). **Tripadvisor Travellers' Choice Best of the Best 2020** Top Luxury Hotels - Spain

Award-Winning Barcelona Escape with Daily Breakfast & Welcome Drinks

Barcelona, Spain

Culture, awe-inspiring architecture, world-class art, history and delicious cuisine: it’s all on offer in the Spanish seaside city of Barcelona - and you are invited to stay right in the heart of the action at the boutique Hotel Sixtytwo. The hotel is rated among the top 1% of properties worldwide on Tripadvisor, and it’s easy to see why. Housed in a 19th-century building with a stunning modernist façade, this boutique gem offers a collection of modern rooms with luxe amenities, beautiful designer furniture and an elegant cocktail bar in one of the best locations in the city. You won’t have to venture far from your room to embrace Barcelona’s cool vibes and rich history. The hotel is ideally placed on one of the most prominent streets in the city, Passeig de Gràcia - known as the Spanish Champs-Elysées - making this the perfect launchpad for your explorations. Step outside the hotel's doors and find yourself a stone’s throw from Gaudi’s masterpieces Casa Batlló, Casa Milà and La Pedrera, bustling Plaza de Catalunya and some of Barcelona’s best boutique shops, cool bars and restaurants - city escapes don’t get much better than this. **Luxury Escapes inclusions (select nights/packages)** - Fuel city exploration with **deluxe daily continental breakfast** - Enjoy a **welcome drink on arrival** - **Upgrade to a Superior Room**, subject to availability (Interior Rooms only, for stays of 4+ nights) **Travelling with kids?** Check out the Family Room for two adults and two children (aged 11 years and under) **Tripadvisor Travellers' Choice, Best of the Best 2021** Top 25 Hotels - Spain
